page.content:
Carthaginian general who brought the war over the Alps.

How Hannibal connects

  • Event: Punic Wars — Hannibal was Carthage's general in the Second Punic War.
  • Event: Battle of Cannae — Hannibal destroyed the Roman army at Cannae.
  • Character: Scipio Africanus — Scipio defeated Hannibal at Zama.

What is Hannibal?

Hannibal Barca won Trebia, Trasimene, and Cannae in Italy, failed to take Rome, and was finally beaten by Scipio in Africa — the Republic's defining foreign enemy.

Key threads lead to Punic Wars, Battle of Cannae and Scipio Africanus.
